summary: Tested Coach chat sessions. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass. The suite covers CRUD, rename validation, 404s, 401, cross-user isolation with a temp Rider, and delete removing only the session's own messages. It also runs /coach/chat in-process with a MOCKED LlmChat (no token spend), verifying session_id is persisted and LLM session_id is user+session scoped, that one session's history never leaks into another session's prompt, and that a chat without session_id auto-creates a session. Frontend tested at /pos as Owner, desktop 1920 and mobile 390, with /api/coach/chat route-mocked. Working: history overlay, header and overlay New Chat (clears and does not auto-select), selecting a session loads only its messages, and sending from a new chat creates and selects a session with the reply shown. ContextInfo works: Sisa Stock, Laporan Produk, Laporan Penjualan, Stock Rider, fallback category name. Placement is correct (Coach left, info right, both above the mobile bottom nav), no horizontal overflow, no app console errors. One bug: deleting the currently selected session auto-selects the next session and loads its messages. Ran reset_final_revision.py at the end: Owner only, coach_sessions/coach_chats/sessions = 0.

minor.issue: If the LLM call throws, the auto-created or pre-created empty 'Chat baru' session remains, and the frontend always pre-creates one via POST /coach/sessions. Empty sessions can pile up in history.
Legacy endpoint without session_id still returns all of the user's chats across sessions. It is not used by the new UI; remove it or keep it intentionally.

ui_bugs.issue: Deleting the CURRENTLY selected session sets sessionId=null but leaves newChatRef.current=false. The loadSessions effect re-runs (sessionId is a dependency) and auto-selects data[0]. Repro: select session B, delete it, and A is now highlighted with its messages ('TEST_alpha question') shown. Expected: selection and message list stay cleared. Fix: set newChatRef.current = true when targetSessionId === sessionId.

issues: The Coach button (fixed left-4 lg:bottom-20) sits over the left sidebar just above 'Keluar' and is not aligned vertically with the info button (lg:bottom-6). Consider offsetting it past the sidebar (e.g. lg:left-[250px]) or aligning both bottoms.

action_items: CoachChat.jsx deleteSession: when deleting the active session, set newChatRef.current = true (or skip auto-select) so another session is not auto-loaded.
Optional: avoid orphan empty sessions. Either let /coach/chat create the session lazily (drop the frontend pre-create), or delete or skip empty sessions on LLM failure.
Optional: move the desktop Coach button off the sidebar.
critical_code_review_comments: CoachChat send(): setSessionId(new) fires the GET messages effect while the chat POST is in flight. This works because the LLM is slow (the GET resolves first with []), but if the GET resolves after setMsgs append it would overwrite the list. Consider skipping the fetch for a freshly created session.
loadSessions useCallback depends on sessionId, so every selection change re-fetches /coach/sessions (extra requests).
The Rider 'zulfikar' found in the DB at test start (not created by this agent) was removed by the reset.

context_for_next_testing_agent: POS requires a PIN-pad unlock (pin-key-1..9). UI login: fill login-identifier-input, click login-continue-button, click the first input in pin-inputs and type the PIN. API-cookie injection via page.request did not keep the session in the browser. Mock /api/coach/chat with page.route and a ~2.5s delay to mimic the LLM. The in-process pytest patches sys.modules['emergentintegrations.llm.chat'] and uses httpx ASGITransport with base_url https://testserver. Run reset_final_revision.py at the end.
rca of the issue: deleteSession clears sessionId without setting newChatRef. The loadSessions useEffect([open, loadSessions]) re-runs because loadSessions' identity depends on sessionId, and since sessionId and newChatRef are both falsy it picks data[0].
